programs.title: The Client
programs.desc: 11-year-old Mark Sway is torn between what he knows and what he can never tell. A hitman will kill Mark if the boy reveals what he knows about a Mob murder. Am ambitious federal prosecutor will keep the pressure on until Mark tells all. Mark is now a pawn in a deadly game, and his only ally is a courageous attorney who risks her career - and unexpectedly, her life - for him.

programs.title: Staring At Strangers
programs.desc: After his boss fired him, Damian runs away and hides in a closet loaded on a van. When the closet arrives at its buyers, he decides to stay there...

programs.title: The Movie Show

programs.title: The Movie Show

programs.title: Madison
programs.desc: 13-year-old Madison lives for cycle racing, striving to match her successful pro-cyclist dad. When she's forced to trade her road bike for a mountain bike, her talent is tested and chaos follows.

programs.title: Another Country
programs.desc: The great Aboriginal Australian actor David Dalaithngu tells the tale of 'Another Country', a story of what happened when his people's way of life was interrupted by ours.

programs.title: Discovering Film
programs.desc: A look at the life and career of the two-time Academy Award-winning star of Glory, Training Day, Malcolm X and many more acclaimed films.

programs.title: Ten Canoes
programs.desc: An elder of an Indigenous tribe in Australia's Northern territory realises a youngster on his first geese hunt is tempted to adultery with an elder brother's wife. Therefore he explains how traditionally the youth is told elaborate, edifying stories, like this one, since the earliest existence of the tribe, about how evil slips in, notably by sorcery, and ends up causing immense havoc unless prevented by virtue according to customary tribal law.

programs.title: Samson And Delilah
programs.desc: A glue-sniffing boy and his girlfriend escape the government-controlled no-hope Aboriginal community they live in and go to the city, Alice Springs, looking for a better life.

programs.title: The Most Beautiful Day In The World
programs.desc: A theatre entrepreneur has no talent for art or business, but when a distant relative entrusts him with the care of his nephew, the man discovers he has a phenomenal talent that could change the fate of his business.

programs.title: The Crow's Egg
programs.desc: When Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop, two slum boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice with their own money.

programs.title: Kindred
programs.desc: A journey into the emotional landscape of family, love and loss of two close friends, both Aboriginal, who were adopted by white families and have connected back with their bloodline families.
